# P1 AC1: every command example from the taskboard + taskboard-axi skills, rewritten to tb syntax.
# Run top to bottom by test/tb.test.js against one seeded tbd (temp HOME + TB_HOME + TB_PORT). Order matters.
# Format: <expected exit> | <sh command> [=> <regex the stdout must match>]. The test puts bin/tb on PATH as `tb` and sets TB_HOME.
# Left out on purpose: tcal (Mac Calendar, not tbd) and launchctl lines (host service).
# Seed: t_k3x9qa now, t_m4n5p6 now, t_u1v2w3 next, t_q7r8s9 later, t_x4y5z6 inbox, t_d1d2d3 done.

# dashboard + reads
0 | tb
0 | tb list
0 | tb list --status all
0 | tb list --status now,next
0 | tb list --project Acme --status all
0 | tb list --reminders
0 | tb list --flows
0 | tb grep billing
0 | tb grep "api|workflow" --status later
0 | tb grep review --project Acme
0 | tb list --limit 2
0 | tb get t_k3x9qa
0 | tb show t_k3x9qa
0 | tb get "Review billing"

# writes: add / set / move / done / rm
0 | tb add "Review invoice PR" --project Acme --status now --pos 1 --due 2026-09-25
0 | tb add "Read DDIA ch.6" --project Learning --status later
0 | tb add "Water the plants" --status later --pos bottom
0 | tb add "Call the bank" --status next --pos top --note "ask about the limit"
0 | tb set t_k3x9qa --status now --pos 1
0 | tb set keys --due 2026-09-30 --note "waiting on keys"
0 | tb set "Read DDIA ch.6" --title "Read DDIA ch.7" --project Reading
0 | tb set "Inbox idea" --due none --note none --project none
0 | tb set t_x4y5z6 --status next --pos 1
0 | tb move "Read DDIA ch.5" now --pos 1
0 | tb move t_q7r8s9 later
0 | tb done "Call the bank"
0 | tb done t_k3x9qa t_m4n5p6
0 | tb rm t_d1d2d3
0 | tb rm "Water the plants" "Read DDIA ch.7"

# flows, tags, notifications
0 | tb tag list
0 | tb tag add acme/api --type folder --path "$TB_HOME"
0 | tb tag add acme/web --type git --path "$TB_HOME" --base main => ^added: tag acme/web · git ·
0 | tb tag list
# exit 1: kind not built yet (nothing is built in P1)
1 | tb new "Add retry to the sync job" -f code -t acme/api => kind code not built yet
1 | tb promote t_u1v2w3 -f code -t acme/api => kind code not built yet
0 | tb new "Call the dentist" --status later
0 | tb new "Plan the offsite" --status later --tag acme/api
0 | tb set "Plan the offsite" --tag none => ^updated:
0 | tb show t_u1v2w3 --full => id: t_u1v2w3
0 | tb notify-test => ^notify: not sent

# --help of every verb
0 | tb --help
0 | tb list --help
0 | tb grep --help
0 | tb get --help
0 | tb add --help
0 | tb new --help
0 | tb set --help
0 | tb move --help
0 | tb done --help
0 | tb rm --help
0 | tb promote --help
0 | tb tag add --help
0 | tb tag list --help
0 | tb notify-test --help
0 | tb eval fake --help
